assets.name: gladiatorFrame
promptLines: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI asset, hand-painted World of Warcraft / Ascension
style, chunky silhouette readable at 130px, painterly texture, dark outline, soft upper-left
light, almost front-facing slight three-quarter view. Isolated on genuine transparent alpha, no
text. A round weathered dark bronze gladiator arena shield (parma), iron rivets, deep EMPTY
circular groove around the rim, EMPTY round recessed boss socket at exact centre, small EMPTY
round medallion socket at lower right rim. Straight Roman gladius diagonally BEHIND shield:
leather grip and bronze pommel at lower left, iron blade point upper right. No boss, no blood,
no coin, no magic. Square 512x512 canvas; shield centre (256,256), rim outer diameter 380
pixels; keep sword fully inside canvas. Circular rim must be a perfect circle for registered
overlay assets. Palette dark bronze, iron, sand #b08d3c. No green/purple, no background scene.
Deliver a single frame asset.
